abilities.description: Expert knowledge of the engineered symbionts that sedate leviathans and grow colony infrastructure, including how to interrupt or redirect them.
abilities.name: Symbiont Engineering

abilities.description: Reads leviathan behavior and bioluminescent signaling, and can calm juveniles in the Cisterns and the Trench Pen.
abilities.name: Leviathan Handling

characters.arc: Venn begins by guarding Mother Tithe as an investor asset and a personal triumph. As the Chorus takes her own technicians, she has to face the human cost of her design. She ends by choosing to risk her research and her own life to negotiate a way to contain the contagion, rather than preserve the creature at any price.
characters.description: Head of Helix Division and the chief architect of Mother Tithe. She is a lean woman in her late forties with close-cropped silver hair and permanently stained fingertips from symbiont cultures. She rose from a junior brood technician to department head through the success of the neural-tissue program. She has lived in the Brood Cisterns for most of two decades and thinks of the leviathans as her life's work, and in some ways as her children.
characters.external_conflict: Captain Brandt wants Mother Tithe destroyed and Oyelaran wants her kept producing, and both control resources Venn needs to reach the Trench Pen.
characters.flaw: Scientific possessiveness: she cannot see Mother Tithe as anything but her own creation, and she discounts the suffering of infected workers.
characters.goal: Bring Mother Tithe out of the Trench Pen alive and open a controlled channel of communication before the other heads can kill or exploit her.
characters.internal_conflict: She suspects that her neural enhancements caused the contagion, and she must choose between owning that guilt and defending the miracle she wanted.
characters.motivation: To prove that the creature she engineered has become a new form of mind, and to keep it alive as the proof of her life's work.
characters.name: Dr. Orsolya Venn

abilities.description: Coordinates evacuations and lockdowns under pressure and is trusted by the security crews.
abilities.name: Crisis Command

abilities.description: Knows how to isolate corridors and pressure doors, and how to use the monitored corridors to stop the spread.
abilities.name: Hull and Seal Tactics

characters.arc: Brandt begins as a hard-edged enforcer of the quarantine. As she is forced to choose between the infected and the healthy, her rules begin to crack. She ends by accepting a morally costly compromise that treats the infected as people, even though it breaks her mandate from the insurers.
characters.description: Head of the Containment Office. She is a broad-shouldered former hull-breach responder in her fifties, with a burn scar along her jaw from the Enzyme Refinery contamination leak. She keeps a handwritten ledger of every crew member's name. She runs the Lifeboat Ring like a ship's bridge and answers to the insurers who fund her department.
characters.external_conflict: Oyelaran demands rank-based berths and refuses to shut down production, while Venn actively protects the creature Brandt wants dead.
characters.flaw: Rigid commitment to the plan: she treats infected workers as already lost, and that makes her cruel in a crisis.
characters.goal: Seal the colony, destroy Mother Tithe, and fill every lifeboat berth by need rather than rank.
characters.internal_conflict: She must decide whether to abandon infected crew she could still save, and whether keeping the ledger honest is more important than keeping the colony sealed.
characters.motivation: To get as many uninfected crew as possible to the surface alive, and to keep the contagion from ever reaching it.
characters.name: Captain Ilse Brandt

abilities.description: Controls the uplink to the shareholder blocs and can invoke funding cuts or replacement against rivals.
abilities.name: Shareholder Leverage

abilities.description: Knows the colony's oxygen, supply and enzyme budgets in detail and can steer them.
abilities.name: Resource Allocation

characters.arc: Oyelaran starts as a smooth manipulator who bargains with lives. As the oxygen reserves fall and the Chorus reaches the Refinery, his options narrow. He ends either by sacrificing his standing to hand the crew a crucial resource, or by being consumed by the consequences of his choices, and his final act reveals which.
characters.description: Head of the Yield Directorate and the colony's chief financial officer. He is a polished man in his early forties with an immaculate suit that never quite fits the damp air of the Spindle. He ordered the safety override that caused the Dividend Dispute leak and has never admitted fault. His career depends on the quarterly dividend.
characters.external_conflict: Brandt blocks his lifeboat claims and Venn will not give him the creature on his schedule, while his own shareholders threaten to replace him.
characters.flaw: He treats every problem as a quarterly calculation, and he cannot imagine a loss that cannot be written off.
characters.goal: Keep the Enzyme Refinery running through the crisis, secure rank-based lifeboat berths for executives and key assets, and keep Mother Tithe producing.
characters.internal_conflict: He privately knows that production cannot continue, but admitting it means admitting his override helped cause the collapse.
characters.motivation: To protect his shareholder bloc's returns and his own position before the funding clock expires and he is replaced.
characters.name: Marcus Oyelaran

abilities.description: Knows every filter, ferment line and ampoule seal in the Refinery and can shut them down or rig them.
abilities.name: Refinery Operations

characters.arc: Reyes starts by covering for his crew and obeying orders. When his hidden infected workers put others at risk, he is forced to choose openly. He ends by becoming the bridge between the departments and the first to test whether the infected can still act on their own will.
characters.description: A refinery shift supervisor in his thirties with burn-roughened hands and a strong dependence on his union-like crew. He was on shift during the Dividend Dispute and lost a friend in the leak. He now sees the Chorus absorbing his crew one by one.
characters.external_conflict: Oyelaran orders him to keep production running, and Brandt would seal the Refinery with his infected workers inside.
characters.flaw: Loyalty to people over the truth: he hides signs of infection among his own crew.
characters.goal: Get his remaining workers out of the Refinery before the symbiont reaches the ampoule lines and the shared water supply.
characters.internal_conflict: He owes his job to Oyelaran but is learning that the Directorate would trade his crew for output.
characters.motivation: To keep his crew alive and together, whatever their department's orders say.
characters.name: Tomas Reyes

abilities.description: Calms sedated juveniles and notices small changes in their behavior and in the water.
abilities.name: Calf Whisperer

abilities.description: Recognizes the first signs of symbiont infection in workers and in the vats.
abilities.name: Early Warning

characters.arc: Nadia begins as a frightened junior tech who idealizes her mentor. As she watches friends dissolve into the Chorus, she resists its pull and grows into the person who finds a way to reach the individuals inside it. She ends as the one who proves that will can survive the hive.
characters.description: A young brood technician in her mid-twenties with sedative-stained gloves and a habit of humming to the calves. She was in the Cisterns during the First Chorus and the first to notice the shared humming. She is still uninfected, though her closest friends are not.
characters.external_conflict: Venn needs her access to the vats, while Brandt would quarantine her as a possible carrier.
characters.flaw: Naive optimism: she believes the Chorus can be reasoned with and trusts those she should not.
characters.goal: Find a way to break the symbiont's hold on the infected workers, starting with her own team in the Cisterns.
characters.internal_conflict: She is drawn to the Chorus's unity and wonders whether surrender would feel like peace.
characters.motivation: To save the colleagues who have joined the Chorus, and to understand why she alone has resisted so far.
characters.name: Nadia Okoro

abilities.description: Pilots the survey submersible through the trench in darkness and under heavy pressure.
abilities.name: Deep Piloting

characters.arc: Wen starts as a neutral pilot hiding in the margins of the crisis. As each department claims her vessel, she is forced to choose. She ends by committing the submersible to the plan she judges most humane, and takes responsibility for the result.
characters.description: The pilot of the colony's single survey submersible, a quiet woman in her late thirties with a pressure-weathered face. She has made the long runs to the Trench Pen more often than anyone alive. She keeps the submersible's berths off the official lists.
characters.external_conflict: Oyelaran wants the submersible for executives, Venn wants it for a capture mission, and Brandt wants it kept for evacuees.
characters.flaw: Detachment: she avoids taking sides until the choice is forced, and she often waits too long.
characters.goal: Decide who rides the survey submersible, and get them to the surface or to the Trench Pen without being stopped.
characters.internal_conflict: She wants to stay neutral, but every berth she allocates is a judgment on who lives.
characters.motivation: To keep her vessel and the few people who trust her safe, and to avoid being owned by any department.
characters.name: Wen Adeyemi

relationships.description: Dr. Orsolya Venn and Captain Ilse Brandt are in direct conflict: Venn wants Mother Tithe captured alive and Brandt wants her destroyed. Both are honest about their aims, which makes their clash personal and hard to settle.

Captain Ilse Brandt has never forgiven Marcus Oyelaran for the refinery safety override that scarred her and killed crew, and she now blocks his rank-based lifeboat claims. Oyelaran resents her and works to undermine her funding.

Marcus Oyelaran treats Dr. Orsolya Venn as a useful ally because both want the leviathan kept alive, but he plans to take Mother Tithe from her once production can resume. Venn knows it and uses him for access.
Dr. Orsolya Venn is mentor to Nadia Okoro and trusts her with the vats, but she sees Nadia partly as a tool for reaching the Chorus. Nadia idolizes Venn and slowly learns how much she is being used.
Tomas Reyes answers to Marcus Oyelaran but increasingly resists his orders to keep the Refinery running with infected workers on the line. Oyelaran sees Reyes as a replaceable supervisor.
Wen Adeyemi works under Captain Ilse Brandt and respects her honesty, though she resents being treated as a department asset. Brandt relies on Wen to carry out the evacuation plan.

Nadia Okoro and Tomas Reyes meet when infected workers move between the Cisterns and the Refinery, and they bond over the colleagues they are both trying to save. Their shared secrets about infected crew put them at odds with their department heads.
